risk_if_not_implemented: Without Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: File Activity Monitoring (FAM)
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to monitor sensitive and/or regulated data in Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and data repositories.
compensating_control_1.justification: File Activity Monitoring (FAM) (MON-28) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) (END-09) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cryptographic Hash
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize hash algorithms to generate a hash value that can be used to validate the integrity of data and/or software.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cryptographic Hash (CRY-14) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) (END-09) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
